# Stanford University <span class='zh-inline'>(斯坦福大学)</span>

<img src="logos/stanford.png" alt="Stanford University identifier" width="150" style="display:block;margin:0 0 1.4rem 0">

A university whose CS department became the launching pad for Google and whose lecture notes trained a generation of AI researchers.

> 这所学校的计算机系是 Google 的起跑线，它的讲义培训了一代又一代 AI 研究者。

## Background (背景)

Founded in 1885 by Leland and Jane Stanford as a memorial to their son, the university opened on 1 October 1891. Its location in Silicon Valley shaped a department closely tied to industry.

> 斯坦福大学由 Leland 与 Jane Stanford 于 1885 年创办以纪念他们的儿子，1891 年 10 月 1 日开学。位于硅谷的地理位置塑造了它与产业界紧密相连的计算机系。

## Notable people (名人)

**Larry Page** and **Sergey Brin** — Stanford graduate students who co-developed PageRank and co-founded Google in 1998. **Fei-Fei Li** — Stanford professor and lead instructor of CS231n. **Andrew Ng** — Stanford adjunct professor and longtime instructor of CS229.

> **Larry Page** 与 **Sergey Brin** — 斯坦福研究生，共同开发 PageRank 并于 1998 年创办 Google。**李飞飞** — 斯坦福教授，CS231n 主讲。**Andrew Ng** — 斯坦福兼职教授，长期主讲 CS229。

## Notable CS courses (著名计算机课程)

CS106A Programming Methodology · CS161 Design and Analysis of Algorithms · CS107 Programming Paradigms · CS229 Machine Learning · CS231n Deep Learning for Computer Vision.

> CS106A 编程方法学 · CS161 算法设计与分析 · CS107 编程范式 · CS229 机器学习 · CS231n 计算机视觉深度学习。
